dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And how does that explain why you're staying?

dialogues.speaker: Vidya
dialogues.text: During that brief performance, people did not need to question where their laughter or tears came from, or whether those feelings were justified.

dialogues.speaker: Vidya
dialogues.text: All we had to do was follow the actors' songs and dances. Before reason had time to judge them, we already knew whose fate to cheer for, whose sorrow to weep over, and whose fear to share as if it were our own.

dialogues.speaker: Vidya
dialogues.text: Is this why Snezhnaya holds theater in such high regard? Maybe the whole point of it is to guide people's emotions and give those feelings somewhere to go. There is no need to analyze it or judge it.

dialogues.speaker: Vidya
dialogues.text: What a performance with so much to discuss... If I could see just a little more, even ten minutes, perhaps it would be enough to push my research forward.

dialogues.speaker: Vidya
dialogues.text: Maybe there is still an encore... Maybe if I stay a little longer, I will get those ten minutes after all...
